findings.summary: Global item edits can silently disable tenant catalog config
findings.details: tenantConfig?.enabled ?? false defaulted to false when tenantConfig was absent, silently disabling items.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — fixed: upsertConfig now guarded by `if (tenantConfig != null)`, enabled reads tenantConfig.enabled directly
findings.recommendation: Do not upsert tenant config from the global item form unless tenant-specific fields actually changed and the current config has been fetched for that exact item.

findings.summary: Concurrent approval failures leave stale actionable rows
findings.details: 409 closes the dialog but does not invalidate ['approval-queue'], so the actioned row stays visible for up to 5 minutes.
findings.tierReason: severity=medium — does not meet blocking threshold
findings.recommendation: Invalidate ['approval-queue'] on 409/404 before closing the dialog.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
